findings.evidence: template/scripts/run_test_groups.py:189-190 passes lease descriptors only to the immediate unittest process. Tests then launch further workers without pass_fds—for example tests/test_parallel_lifecycle_acceptance.py:20 launches parallel_lifecycle_acceptance.py through subprocess.Popen. Those launches close the lease descriptors by default. If the runner and unittest process are killed, the surviving validation worker holds no lease, so another run can acquire the tokens while that worker continues. This contradicts the documented guarantee that tokens remain held until the run and every child it started have exited; the orphan test in tests/test_machine_pool.py covers only a direct child explicitly given pass_fds.
findings.summary: Pool tokens can be released while validation descendants are still running after their parents are killed.
